summary: Polar Power, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting issuance of a $275,000 convertible promissory note to Mayers Ventures LLC for $250,000, bearing 10% interest maturing December 30, 2027. The note allows conversion at 90% of the lowest 7-day VWAP with a floor while listed. Mayers may designate one board member. This is a routine financing, not a special-situation event. There are no deal terms as defined; note terms are standard for unregistered convertible debt. What to watch: potential dilution from conversions, but no transformative event.
